title: Transfer: Audit Clinician Roster Aliases Against a Licensing Registry
goal: Match messy clinician names from shift rosters to a licensing registry despite initials, token order changes, and minor spelling errors, then output unresolved or mismatched credential cases to /root/license_exceptions.csv.
skillBenefitRationale: This task transfers the skill from company-name reconciliation to person-name reconciliation, where fuzzy matching is essential to connect roster aliases to the correct licensed clinician record.
